Doorbell

Qualification journey for the free Google Nest doorbell offer.

QUALIFIERS Only offer if the destination home is over 2,000 sq. ft. and they own / are buying the destination home.

Step 1 — Destination Size

Only continue if the destination home is over 2,000 sq. ft.

After Booking — Wrap Up The Call

Excellent, I've got everything reserved for you and here shortly you'll receive your confirmation email along with a copy of your estimate. Here's what happens next: One of our operations managers will be giving you a call in the next day or two to personally introduce themselves and answer any additional questions that may have come up between now and then. And one last question before we wrap up — are we moving you into a home you've purchased or a rental property?

Step 2 — Ownership

Choose the option that matches the destination home.

Homeowner Script

Great. As an All My Sons customer and homeowner, you're entitled to a complimentary security assessment on your new home through our partners at SafeHaven. You'll also receive a professionally installed Google Nest Doorbell simply for taking the assessment. When our operations department reaches out to introduce themselves, they can connect you directly. Would you like me to note that you're interested?

Accepted Doorbell Script

I went ahead and noted that. You're all set for the move, the security assessment from SafeHaven and the complimentary doorbell. Keep a look out for that call from operations I mentioned, and thanks again for your business!
Important: If they accept, be sure to mark the Door Bell Promotion button and CONFIRM the destination address is correct and grammatically correct.
IF NO 👀

They Decline

Leave the door open — it's a no-pressure complimentary gift.

No problem. If you change your mind at any time let us know. Otherwise you're all set, look out for the call from operations, and thanks again for your business!

Renter Script

Okay, great. If the property owner has any special requests regarding the move-in, please let us know. Otherwise you're all set, look out for the call from operations, and thanks again for your business!

Objections

Objection: "I don't want to deal with setup." Your Response: "Completely understand — that's the best part. Our partners at SafeHaven handle the full professional install for you, so there's nothing for you to set up." Objection: "Is there a catch?" Your Response: "No catch at all — it's a complimentary welcome gift from All My Sons through our partnership with ADT. No obligation and no contract required for the doorbell." Objection: "I need to talk to my spouse." Your Response: "Of course — no rush at all. It's a standing complimentary gift, so just let us know whenever you're ready and we'll get you marked down for it."

Pro Tips

🎯
Book First, Offer SecondOnly bring up the doorbell once the move is fully booked and scheduled — never use it to win the booking.
🏠
Homeowner = TriggerSaying 'because you're moving into a home you own' creates exclusivity and makes the gift feel earned, not random.
🤝
It's a Welcome GiftFrame it as appreciation, not a sale. 'A welcome gift from All My Sons' lands better than 'an offer.'
🔒
ADT Partnership CredibilityIf asked, mention this is part of our partnership with ADT — installed by our partners at SafeHaven.
⏱
Keep It BriefThese scripts are intentionally short. Deliver the line and let silence work for you. Don't over-explain.
📋
Always DocumentCheck the box on the Estimate form.

💼 Let's Talk Commissions!

Welcome team! This is your go-to guide for getting your commission sheets done right, on time, and without headaches. Follow these rules and keep that money flowing 💰

⏰ Timing Is Everything

Commission sheets are based on completed moves only for that payroll period.

  • Every Monday morning, block off your first hour ⏳
    → This is your dedicated commission time.
  • Your sheet is due ONE HOUR after your official start time.
🧾 Filling Out Your Sheet
  • ✅ Use the correct sheet (the one that applies to YOU)
  • ✅ ALL fields are required — no blanks!
  • ✅ ALL formulas must remain intact

🚨 If anything is missing or incorrect, your sheet WILL be sent back.

⚡ Speed Matters

If payroll is late, we cannot guarantee it will be processed on time.

  • If your sheet gets sent back:
    👉 Fix it ASAP and resubmit immediately.
📧 How to Submit
  • Include Nick AND Brian on every email
    → This ensures nothing gets missed if someone is out
  • Attach your sheet as a FILE (not a link) 📎
  • Name your file:
    👉 Your Name – Commission Sheet
🌴 Out of Office? No Problem

If you're going to be out of town:

  • Fill out everything you can on the sheet
  • Leave "Total Collected for all CIDs" blank
  • Send it to Nick & Brian to complete

📌 Reason: Estimator auto-pay isn't always 100% accurate

🆘 Need Help?

Don't get stuck!
📞 Reach out to Nick or Brian anytime
We're here to help you get it done right the first time.

Backhaul Information

📋 Backhaul SOP
📝 Backhaul Lead Form
Fill out the form above to send to backhaul team
Form Includes 9 Questions (ALL REQUIRED):
  • CID
  • Customer Name
  • Weight
  • Packing
  • Pick-up Dates
  • Origin
  • Destination
  • Direct Service Price
  • Customer Budget & Flexibility
⚠️ Key Questions to Ask Customer:
  • Pick-up/Drop-off Flexibility: Ask if customer has flexibility with pick-up or drop-off dates
  • Budget: Ask customer their budget for the move
✓ Likelihood of Backhaul:
Budget is within 30% of direct service price AND customer has 1+ week flexibility on pick-up/drop-off dates = Likely something will work
🔴 IMPORTANT - DO NOT BOOK UNTIL:
  • Backhaul team emails you to book the job
  • Customer has direct service pricing estimate in CMS1 first
  • Form submission DOES NOT guarantee a backhaul will be found
  • Do NOT change pricing from direct service until backhaul confirms
✓ ONCE BACKHAUL CONFIRMS:
  • Send a quote out with the correct price that backhaul confirmed
  • Use Option 2 without insurance
  • Include the backhaul customer remarks in the HUB
❓ What is a Backhaul?

All My Sons has over 100 offices across the country. We're constantly delivering items to different cities, and after completing a direct service delivery, our truck must return empty to its home office.

Here's where backhauling comes in:

Scenario: Our truck just delivered items to Miami and is returning to Dallas. At the same time, another customer needs their items moved FROM Dallas TO Miami.

Solution: Instead of sending an empty truck back, we use that same truck to move the other customer's items. Since the truck is already driving that route and would be empty anyway, we can offer a discounted rate for this move.

⚠️ Important: This is NOT a standard service All My Sons offers. Backhauling is a special opportunity that only works when the timing and route perfectly align with our existing deliveries.
